svg.text: Archived Qwen automated-review P1 flags, normalized per 100 samples
A. Extraction P1 flags across PDAC development
B. Extraction P1 flags by clinical category
The dashed segment marks expansion from the fixed 30-note subset to the 100-note development set. Case mix changed at this boundary.
Counts describe issues flagged by the historical automated reviewer. They are not clinician-confirmed error rates.
The reviewer rubric changed during early D-stage iterations and no exact prompt hash was stored.
